title: My character skinned in 3dsmax looks a bit different after exporting as an open-collada format.
content: Skinning an avatar in 3dsmax includes two categories called "Skin" and "Physics". An Open-Collada file format can only support the "Skin" way perfectly. If you face an issue importing an Open Collada file or importing an avatar including animation, please try with FBX either Alembic file format with PC2.
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on skinning avatars in 3ds Max, highlighting the compatibility of Open-Collada with skinning, and offering solutions for importing animated avatars through FBX or Alembic file formats.

title: Shirring and Crease Principle
content: ### Shirring principle In this course, we will explore the different types of shirring shapes based on fabric. In addition to the wrinkles generated by the default fabric, there are various types of wrinkles, such as narrow wrinkles and wide wrinkles. You can achieve the desired wrinkles by adjusting the Detail items in the Fabric Property, but it may be challenging for beginners. However, if you understand the differences in how each fabric forms wrinkles, you can easily create various styles of wrinkles. ### Crease principle In this course, we will learn about the shape of creases based on fabric. When fabrics are stretched or overlapped with each other, various creases are formed based on the type of fabric. Following the Shirring principle, you can refer to the creases made for each fabric and apply them to the clothes you plan to create in the future.
content_description: This webpage serves as a guide to understanding and mastering the principles of shirring and creasing in fabric design, enabling users to create a variety of wrinkle styles and apply them effectively in their clothing projects.

title: How can I delete the account?
content: Understand how to delete account on Marvelous Designer. 1. Delete account after unsubscribing current license/plan 2. Delete account immediately ## ## **Details** #### #### **1) Delete Account after unsubscribing current licenses** 1\. Visit “My Account” page from **[Marvelous Designer](https://www.marvelousdesigner.com/mypage/account)** to start the account deletion process. ![스크린샷 2025-05-21 오후 4.26.22.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438105606169) 2\. Click "Delete My Account" button at the bottom of "Account" tab. ![스크린샷 2025-05-21 오후 4.29.57.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438105832729) 3-1. Click "Delete" button to further proceed. ![스크린샷 2025-05-21 오후 4.33.44.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438091987993) _💡**Note:** If account is using Enterprise license on CLO / Marverlous Design or, account is seller_ _on CONNECT and there is an unsettled amount remaining, you won't be able to delete_ _the account directly. Please click**"Contact US"** button for further assistance._ _*For enterprise user, end user id can ONLY be deleted on the license admin page_ ![mceclip3.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438078459545) 4\. Current license/plan will be displayed and must be canceled before account deletion. * All **CLO** and **MD** licenses, as well as any **CLO-SET paid plans** , must be unsubscribed in the area marked as **①**. * **You must leave any CLO-SET groups** in the area marked as **②**. _**💡 Note:** After canceling your licenses and plans, you will still be able to use the service until their expiration date. The “Next” button will become active **only after the end date.**_ ![mceclip6.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438078688665) #### **2) Delete Account immediately** 1. To immediately delete the account without waiting for the license/plan end date, click the “Delete My Account” button in the area marked as ③ _💡**Note:** Please note that any active paid plans and associated data will be immediately terminated and deleted upon proceeding. title: When I try to login, I get the following massage "Due to a network issue, you are unable to login at this time"
content: This error message occurs when there is a failure between server connections. In case you are receiving this message while using the Marvelous Designer 8, then please first check if your network connection is stable or you have input wrong password or not. If you input the right login credential, you would be able to activate the license successfully with the onlineauth method. If you keep facing this issue however, please refer to the ([manual page](https://marvelousdesigner-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/47358427341465)) for offline authentication method activation. For all the other versions with the same issue, please follow the instructions below for its solution. Also, please make our server address whitelist on your antivirus program. ![with.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438097204377) * **With “Firewall Option” enabled** 1. Open HTTPS port 443 which is the blocked server. 2. When you login, please check on the box saying “If using a Firewall, mark this checkbox”. 3. Make the Marvelous Designer’s server whitelisted. If you are residing in China, please use the second address. 1. IP: 52.1.24.50 (api.clo3d.com ) 2. IP: 52.20.29.14 (api.clo3d-china.com) 4. Please activate the license. ![without.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438112145689) * **With “Firewall Option” disabled** 1. Open HTTPS port 443 which is the blocked server. 2. Make the Marvelous Designer’s server whitelisted. If you are residing in China, please use the second address. 1. IP: 52.1.24.50 (api.clo3d.com ) 2. IP: 52.20.29.14 (api.clo3d-china.com) 3. Please activate the license. **[How to open port 443 and whitelist Marvelous Designer’s server IP address.]** **1\. Open the control panel and go to 'Windows Defender Firewall' sections.** ![Xwaqc1aLWHzM0RKZWm5Phggk3suThFUkJYj8AIe7kiWJIdr1DvYVne9eXxunzy2oFpxgfCGTWT7OPnfYklNbMjQD1OZkb12QfrdXCgXTfNQg2ElNrH3XOkZgh0sxKfcA4Vq1Zto5.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438162539801) **2 Go to 'Advanced settings' and click 'Inbound Rules'.** ![4dK68hcJOhqp7mRu0Ym7az9xExTFwR7xOm1065mQKOZaepfbn7xVpMjt3QrpwPni6VgAz0o9izAL9mXmMSkj4ed8izWStWhv-ydTtMO45nV5svqIprl4bK0cDmT2u3P45nhyoTVB.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438097738905) **3\. On 'Action' menu, click 'New Rule'.** ![zTxrlfuGDX5qr_TWWaT4fssmuj3lCguT9KoHMrOFsdNrmAA3Gf6c_T05SbqupRo7-PO6V2WNSwNPF4IbcpN656bYALlITJ1OZlbkB_G7c08E62HLJURs9cOOjuKjGwZ078BQyl4Y.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438098004761) **4\. Select 'Port' and click 'Next'.** ![JNVEfASi4Iquw6yPPEvNK3pG3yjuO_61SBCDjwaTJpIbI5Jlp1Mhmqugrt9AQHyMnm7EMuul04yu4XidQ7XmXjvcNHtGFvA1s7vidFOJhITMcjRuWvPKbyGFOUEDTJPLiSepBU8-.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438098300441) **5\. Select 'TCP' and input '443' on the 'Specific local ports' section.** ![1gZV5mqSlg-TnT3TbECybl1oarVggQvu1TldW7TVY_PqVap4zsDpYfz1yRoelGvIpzWI754ksplWuGoM-ucNsxvw_cEAXEimq8qQOgSJTGfKuPsUu2RRZpsIarozrwRkfGZ4UtBD.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438145964441) **6\. Select 'Allow the connection' and click 'Next'.** ![KRcTmTLslRbRy1U_1WgfWS7KevQ7JGMG79Jw7QQZTIqLOgTQ73n7MqqQCSlravyldXSZVVzt_HPxBXWCN-3GnSp-64SJOMtsJQAN7QcWRzOUtPQJf7rkmocFxxOa1BYBlFBYbGeP.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438148995353) **7\. Input the rule name and click 'Finish'.** ![nOYjpKgChfk0KkSqsyWCrrFTfH8dszdhJdu7d3-BEFiNwpyNrujQnC69AxXjrD2r_IbNMBLpd9arzeJ0i-PXnHJYvUTwLouzyEU88eB5byQg7A_TW1ZBMgoAjLbyhl1p69HeDp3z.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438163877273) **9\. Go to the 'Scope' and select 'These IP addresses' on the 'Remote IP address' window, and click 'Add'.** ![MctTcujBgKVx0tipYoKY0DYDjheVSJk_CUCDu5k7wLEz2naSBm1qTmNCr8rZqv8x3TzNrGa_lzLYmQQVGJqcdz06kZEq41_1vx1pysv_RWFPa7NxRfUpKJWwBNrKycCLSeRHAzod.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438149915545) **11\. Input the following info on the 'This IP address or subnet' and click 'OK'.** ![c_3KC_I_mHFKs1h0IygAWZriUWzDwn4_iYG3tI379M0n7weixajkYIFZkQhNy5Uu_axnJ62jInfQvjzbqPuRimAz9mIzZBsKqgd2iqKx9X4xkFNlWGIotp9ERjxAQQ8ENatIiEUf.png](https://support.marvelousdesigner.com/hc/article_attachments/47438150128537) **In case you are still experiencing this issue after the guideline above, please refer to the instructions below.** **Step 1.** Open c:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\host file as a text file **Step 2.** Add # at the front for the lines that includes api.clo3d.com or sapi.clo3d.com After add # for the lines in the front, please try to login again.

title: Can I use Marvelous Designer for physical garment production?
content: Marvelous Designer is generally used in the video production or the game industries to create virtual garments and props, which means that Marvelous designer does not offer several functions that are essential in physical garment production. (e.g. to import/export DXF, to print out the paper patterns). If you are looking for a software to help you with proceeding the physical garment, we would like to introduce you to our sister software 'CLO 3D.' Visit [www.clo3d.com](http://www.clo3d.com) or contact us at [sales@clo3d.com](mailto:sales@clo3d.com)

title: Compatible File Format
content: ### Compatible File Format File | Format | Import | Export | Detail ---|---|---|---|--- 3D | FBX | *.fbx | O | O | File contains Mesh, Material, Joint, Animation, and Camera information. *Only Joint that was imported as FBX to Marvelous Designer can be exported as FBX. Open COLLADA | *.dae | O | X | This file can be exported from other 3D softwares such as 3ds Max, Maya and used. These files contain geometry and material, also in a addition to rigging, skinning, and animation data When exporting OpenCOLLADA files from 3DS Max or Maya, install the “OpenCOLLADA plugin ([http://www.opencollada.org](http://www.opencollada.org/)) and export to use the avatar OBJ | *.obj | O | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Primarily used for importing Avatar and related sources into the program. LXO | *.lxo | X | O | File contains Geometry and Material Information. Used to export Apparel/Avatar information to Modo in the LXO file format. Animation Cache | *.mc *.pc2 *.mdd | O | O | Is the vertex animation data. It is possible to take animations made in Marvelous Designer to 3DSMax or Maya in point cache format. Alembic | *.abc | O | O | Is an interchange file format for computer graphics that saves both vertex and animation information. ※ Mac export (ver. 5.1.431) 3D Snapshot | *.png | - | O | Ability to save single views of the 3D window in the PNG file format. 2D | Texture | *.jpg, *.png, etc. | O | O | Textures inserted into garments, use image textures in formats such as JPG, PNG, TIF, and PSD. Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, wbmp, psd, ico, tga, tif, tiff, gif, mng, jng, dds, hdr, koa, lbm, iff, pbm, pcd, pcx, pgm, ppm, ras, cut, xmb, xpm, sgi, g3, exr, j2k, jp2, pfm, pict, pct) Substance | .sbsar | O | - | File contains procedural texture information with adjustable parameters. The separate channels of a Substance material can be baked and exported (color, normal, metalness, roughness, opacity)
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive overview of compatible file formats for importing and exporting various 3D and 2D assets in Marvelous Designer, detailing the specific capabilities and requirements for each format.
